CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  April 22, 2025

  The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – April 22, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Anki Udani, Chairman; Nora Hernandez, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Stanley Tsai

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR 2024-2025:

  Nomination and election of Chairman, Vice-Chairman and Secretary of the Design Review
  Board for 2025-2026, in accordance with AMC 2.27.060.

  SECRETARY OF DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to have a
  motion on the Secretary of the Design Review Board and select Steve
  Kuchenski [typically the City Architect] as Secretary.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the selected Secretary of Design Review Board.
  •  Moved by Board Member Hernandez, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

  VICE CHAIRMAN OF DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to nominate
  and have a motion on the selected Vice Chairman of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Nomination: Ankit Udani nominated himself.

  MOTION:

  1
  04/22/2025
   •  Moved to approve the selected Vice Chairman of Design Review
  Board.
  •  Moved by Board Member Udani, Seconded by Board Member
  Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

  CHAIRMAN OF DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to nominate
  and have a motion on the selected Chairman of the Design Review
  Board.
  • Nomination: Nora Hernandez nominated by Jennifer Ng

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the selected Chairman of Design Review Board.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – April 8, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the April 8, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the April 8, 2025, Regular Meeting of the
  Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai
  2
  04/22/2025
 E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-023
  • 817 West Hellman Avenue
  • Applicant: Terence Lee
  • Request: This is an application for 32 window replacements on two
  (2) existing residential buildings on a single residential lot.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS - The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1) The applicant shall provide window grids / muntins to the nine
  new windows #A1 through A9 located at the front of the
  property. Window grid / muntin should be permanently applied to
  the exterior of the glass to create a true divided light
  appearance.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The applicant shall provide window grids / muntins to the nine new
  windows #A1 through A9 located at the front of the property.
  Window grid / muntin should be permanently applied to the
  exterior of the glass to create a true divided light appearance.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-23-212
  • 312 Westminster Avenue
  • Applicant: Roger Rodriguez
  • Request: This is an application for a new 502 SF 2nd floor addition
  to an existing single-family residence that includes remodel of the
  existing rear portion of the house, a new patio and 2nd floor deck in
  the rear, and new steps and landing.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  3
  04/22/2025
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise the west elevation to graphically show the existing stone
  underneath the bay window to remain.

  •  Moved by Board Member Udani, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB- 24-145
  • 1809 South Almansor Street
  • Applicant: Juan Reyes
  • Request: This is an application for a new 2,773 SF 2-story addition
  in the rear and a front porch remodel to an existing single-family
  residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The applicant shall provide further detail / information on the
  proposed brick material which should be an authentic and durable
  material.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The applicant shall provide further detail / information on the
  proposed brick material which should be an authentic and durable
  material.
  2) Show overall building height dimensions on all elevations.
  3) Update elevation labels / names to correspond to North, South,
  East, West coordinates.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Tsai
